sentences.text: Hi, could I get a medium oat milk latte, please?
sentences.translation: 你好，我要一杯中杯燕麦拿铁。
sentences.tip: Could I get 连读成 coul-dai-get，语气上扬更礼貌。

sentences.text: Sure. Would you like it hot or iced?
sentences.translation: 好的。你要热的还是冰的？
sentences.tip: hot or iced 三个词要连起来读，重音落在 hot 和 iced。

sentences.text: Iced, please. And can I get an extra shot?
sentences.translation: 冰的，谢谢。可以再加一份浓缩吗？
sentences.tip: extra 的重音在第一音节：EK-stra。

sentences.text: Of course. That'll be four fifty.
sentences.tip: That'll be 缩读成 tha-dl-be，不要逐字念。

sentences.text: Great, thanks. Can I pay by card?
sentences.tip: pay by 连读，card 的 r 要卷舌但别太重。
